title: Glide 2.2.2 is here 🏎️
body:
⚡ Rebuilt efficiency scoring — city driving will now have fair scores. 

🔍 New "Where did I lose points?" — open any trip, or your all-time stats, and see exactly which category cost you.

🗺️ Smarter map — tap anywhere along your route to read the speed you were doing there.

↩️ Corners measured properly — a new gyro-fused force reading holds through the whole turn.

📊 Fairer averages — your all-time scores are now weighted by distance.
